name: pi-cue
description: Get a notification on your iPhone (and Apple Watch) when pi is done or needs you, only when you are away. Uses Bark.
author: purboo

scripts.link-pi: D="$(dirname "$(readlink -f "$(command -v pi)")")/../../.." && mkdir -p node_modules/@earendil-works && for p in pi-ai pi-coding-agent pi-tui; do ln -sfn "$(cd "$D/$p" && pwd)" node_modules/@earendil-works/$p; done
